content.title: SWIM Q2 Deep Dive: Margin Expansion and Sand State Push Offset Revenue Shortfall
content.summary: Residential swimming pool manufacturer Latham (NASDAQ:SWIM) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2025, but sales rose 7.8% year on year to $172.6 million.
